successors.name: Zulu Kingdom
successors.text: the Pongola-to-Tugela country the sibling zululand dossier gives as Shaka's conquest

ledger.x: c. 1780: the Ndwandwe kingdom is established. Infobox 'Established: c. 1780'; rulers 'c. 1780 - 1805: Langa KaXaba' and '1805 - 1825: Zwide kaLanga'; 'settled in the area between the Pongola River and the Black Umfolozi River during the eighteenth century'.
1820: the Ndwandwe kingdom is broken up.

wars.name: Ndwandwe-Zulu war
wars.outcome: Shaka survives Gqokli Hill (1818), then the Ndwandwe are 'decisively defeated' at the Mhlatuze River in early 1820; the kingdom breaks up.

certainty.note: Two river names; no frontier or treaty line; a chiefdom confederacy.
